narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The coil is the biggest symbol, so only the coil moves up to a lotus.
<bookmark mark='read'/>Read his numeral back, and it says only one thousand twenty one.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The heels and the stroke were never made ten times, so his answer is too small.
